entries.en: ...{v:0047}Since we're at it, I'll tell you a little. About{n}the Darkfall.{p}...{FC02}{v:0048}The Darkfall enlarges the distortion in space-time and{n}widens the gaps in it, to draw in Dunkels, whose{n}particles are larger than Grosh.{p}{v:0049}Dunkels are dozens of times larger than Grosh, though,{n}so space-time has to be distorted a great deal for{n}them to get in.
